LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Meander.label: meander floor
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Meander.description: Pale limestone slabs framed by a dark border of the endless key pattern.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Marble.label: marble slabs
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Marble.description: Large slabs of white marble with grey veins, polished smooth. Every temple and every rich house in Hellas stands on them.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Pebbles.label: pebble mosaic
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Pebbles.description: Black and white river pebbles set in mortar in a running wave, the oldest kind of Hellenic mosaic.
